CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2014 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2014 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,266 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 12 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 3 states (survey period: June 2014 to June 2014). These surveys captured 33 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 5 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 998 cards across 41 sites, with 7.3% showing evidence of mouse activity (73 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 116 transects across 41 sites (survey period: June 2014 to June 2014), detecting active burrows in 10.3% of transects (total: 40 active burrows).
